info.description: Backend for Olona — Auth and User Management
info.title: Olona API

get.description: Checks if a username is available for registration.

post.description:
Sends a password reset OTP to the email if it exists. Always
answers 204, whether or not the address has an account, so the
endpoint cannot be used to enumerate registered emails.
Authenticates a user and returns a token pair.
Exchanges a valid refresh token for a new token pair.
Sends a new verification OTP to the user's email.
Resets user password using the OTP received via email.

Registers a new user and sends an OTP for email verification.
A duplicate email is NOT reported as an error. The handler
returns 202 with an identical body to a successful 201 so that
the endpoint cannot be used to discover which addresses have
accounts. Clients must treat 202 as "check your inbox" exactly
as they treat 201 — no error branch exists for that case.
A taken username is reported honestly as 409: it says nothing
about any email address, and no account is created when it is
returned, so masking it would tell the caller a code was sent
for an account that does not exist.
Verifies the 6-digit code sent to the user's email. Returns a token pair upon success.
post.summary: Confirm signup OTP and activate the account

post.description: Consumes an invitation token and adds caller to workspace. Caller email must match recipient email.

403.description: email does not match invitation recipient

get.description: Returns pending governance requests across all child workspaces that caller has oversight authority to approve.

post.description: Approves a pending request and atomically executes the state change. Requester cannot approve their own request.

403.description: requester cannot approve or lack oversight authority

404.description: request not found or already decided

post.description: Cancels an open request. Only the user who originally created the request may cancel it.

404.description: request not found or already decided

post.description: Rejects a pending request with an optional explanation. Requester cannot reject their own request.

404.description: request not found or already decided

get.description: Retrieves the profile of the authenticated user.

delete.description: Allows a user to permanently delete their own account.

patch.description: Updates optional fields of the authenticated user's profile.

post.description: Allows an authenticated user to update their password.

get.description: Returns the workspace switcher list containing all workspaces where the caller has membership or oversight.

post.description:
Creates a root organization workspace (if parent_id is omitted) or a child subsidiary workspace.
When creating a child, the target owner is atomically relocated from the parent.

400.description: invalid body or target owner not admin

get.description: Retrieves workspace metadata along with caller's effective access (tier, origin, and capabilities).

patch.description: Updates workspace name and/or description. Requires workspace.manage_settings capability.

get.description: Returns paginated, immutable audit log events for the workspace. Requires workspace.view_audit capability.
Returns active, unaccepted, unrevoked invitations for the workspace. Requires workspace.manage_members.

post.description: Sends an invitation for a user to join with an admin, member, or viewer tier. Owner tier cannot be invited.

403.description: cannot invite owner or lacking manage_members capability

delete.description: Revokes an active invitation token so it can no longer be used to join.

get.description: Returns active members of the workspace with user profile details. Requires workspace.view capability.

delete.description: Removes an active member from the workspace, or allows caller to voluntarily leave. Sole owner cannot leave.
delete.summary: Remove a member or leave workspace

409.description: sole owner cannot leave without transfer

patch.description: Changes a member's tier and capability set. Cannot demote sole owner or promote directly to owner.

get.description: Returns all governance requests created for a workspace. Requires workspace.view capability.

post.description: Submits a Two-Key Control request (archive, delete, transfer_ownership, move). Requires matching request_* capability.
Unfreezes a previously suspended child workspace via parent oversight authority.
Immediately freezes a child workspace via parent oversight authority. Reversible via resume.

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and the JWT access token.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
